steps: Identify and treat the PRECIPITANT (GI bleed, sepsis/SBP, constipation, hypokalaemia, dehydration, sedatives).
Lactulose titrated to 2–3 soft stools/day (oral or enema).
Add rifaximin for inadequate response / secondary prevention.
Avoid sedatives; do not over-restrict protein; correct electrolytes.
Manage underlying cirrhosis; assess for transplant.

confirm: Confusion/asterixis with chronic liver disease or porto-systemic shunt; a precipitant (GI bleed, infection, constipation, electrolytes, sedatives) is usually present.
